name: Athmonk Steel Wire High Speed Skipping Rope with Metal Handles, 10 ft Adjustable
best_for: People who want a steel-wire speed rope with metal handles and a swivel bearing for cardio, CrossFit or boxing-style training.
pros: The rope is a PVC-coated steel wire, which the listing describes as tangle free
Metal (aluminium) handles with a textured surface for grip
A bearing and 360-degree swivel are listed for smooth rotation
The listing gives the length as 10 ft and adjustable
cons: At 10 ft as listed it is long, so shorter users will need to shorten it: check how the length is adjusted on the Amazon page
The listing is aimed at speed skipping, so it is a different kind of rope from a plain PVC beginner rope
SAT has not tested it: details are as the seller lists them
features: Aluminium handles with textured grip (as listed)
value_for_money: We do not store prices. Check the current price and the colour you want on the Amazon page.
who_should_buy: Skippers who want a speed rope with a steel cable and metal handles, and who are comfortable adjusting the length.
avoid: Anyone who wants a soft, plain rope for a first try, or who is not sure how to shorten a 10 ft rope.
how_to_choose: Stand on the middle of the rope and check that the handles reach about your armpits, then shorten the rope to fit. Compare the handle material and the bearing.
final_recommendation: A steel-wire speed rope with metal handles; check the length and how it is adjusted on the listing before ordering.
